rationale: Saved 024/029 gameplay resumes but createGameRecordSession keeps its independent runId only in memory. Complete requires runId; restoration paths never restore it. Therefore a newly eligible saved RUN loses sharing capability after reload. Unconditionally creating a new record identity on every restore would elevate prefeature saves and permit duplicate results; a local eligibility marker tied to the existing saved-result identity is required. This limits sharing of resumed results without damaging gameplay, original save, or exposing data, so independently classified as an action-required feature gap rather than a major release-risk signal.

actual_next_action.description: Read both restoration branches and result-session guard; verify separate local eligibility provenance, stable one-result deduplication and exclusion of prefeature saves. Test prefeature restore, eligible resume, repeatedreload and finished-result replay before release. These tests are recommended next work, not claimed executions.

bounds: Static independent source inspection. No Jev answer inspection, browser play, player analytics or production post. Ongoing source snapshot, not final source freeze.
